description: This file defines the 'TimestampValueValidator' class, which is responsible for validating timestamp header values by parsing them into OffsetDateTime objects. If parsing fails, it throws an appropriate exception.

classes.name: TimestampValueValidator
classes.description: A singleton class that validates timestamp header values by parsing CharSequences into OffsetDateTime objects, throwing an exception if parsing fails.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of TimestampValueValidator.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Validates the provided header value by attempting to parse it as an OffsetDateTime. Raises an exception if parsing fails.

methods.name: parseOffsetDateTime
methods.description: Parses the CharSequence into an OffsetDateTime object, throwing a DateTimeParseException if invalid.
